subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake — ownership map, asset list & lightweight telemetry samples
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake — ownership map, asset list & lightweight telemetry samples

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for agreeing to share your SOC 2 Type II materials with us as part of the procurement/security intake. To keep this light and fast for your team, we usually ask for three things up front so our security reviewers can validate coverage and estimate any follow-up asks: 

1) Asset & owner map (CSV) — a single flat CSV listing systems, primary owner, environment (prod/stage), and where logs/configs live. We attached a short CSV template (redwood_asset-map-template.csv) you can fill in.

2) Bridge letter or statement of coverage — a short document confirming the audit period and any exceptions (if you have a standard bridge-letter we can accept that; otherwise our sample outlines the minimal points). See soc2-ii-bridge-letter-options.docx attached.

3) Lightweight telemetry sample — a 48–72 hour slice of representative telemetry (ingest events, auth traces, and error rates). We only need a small anonymized sample in CSV or JSON Lines. See telemetry-sample-schema.txt for fields we find most helpful.

Practical notes:
- Ideal delivery: single ZIP with the CSV + bridge letter + telemetry sample.
- If you prefer S3 presigned uploads, we can share a short presign link window (7 days).
- Redaction: please remove PII/PHI; the telemetry schema is purposely small to avoid sensitive values.

Aisha, can you confirm who on your side will own the asset map and who will upload the telemetry? If you want, Monica can host a 20-minute intake call to walk through the template.

Thanks,

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_asset-map-template.csv (CSV)
Attachment: soc2-ii-bridge-letter-options.docx (DOCX)
Attachment: telemetry-sample-schema.txt (TXT)

Hi Tessa,

Appreciate the clear checklist — this is helpful. I can own the asset map and will coordinate telemetry with our Platform team. Quick clarifications: 

• Audit period: our Type II covers 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30. Will that be sufficient, or do you need any additional overlap?
• Telemetry sample: we can provide anonymized auth traces and a short set of application error logs. Is JSON Lines OK?
• Bridge letter: we have a short standard confirmation doc; does it need any specific language about subcontractors or encryption details?

We prefer to upload via a presigned S3 link (if Redwood can issue one). Also, is there a minimum telemetry volume you need for review?

I’ll aim to return the asset map within 48 hours once I confirm a couple owners.

Best,
Aisha

Subject: Re: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake — ownership map, asset list & lightweight telemetry samples

Thanks Aisha — quick answers inline.

On audit period: 2026-07-01 — 2027-06-30 is exactly what we need. Please include that in the bridge letter.

Telemetry format: JSON Lines is perfect. Small anonymized slices (e.g., ~5k–20k lines) are more than enough for an initial pass — we’re looking for sampling of auth success/failure, latency percentiles, and error trace counts, not full retention.

Bridge letter content: the items we usually ask for are: audit period, assertion that the report covers production systems, and note on subcontractors that perform hosting or logging. Explicit encryption-at-rest language is optional but appreciated. Our sample doc has optional clauses you can copy.

Presigned upload: yes, we can send a presigned S3 upload link valid for 7 days. If you prefer a secure drive share, we can use a Google Drive folder instead. Tell us which you prefer and we’ll generate the link.

If Aisha wants a short intake sync, book 15 minutes with Monica (she’s cc’d) — she’ll walk you through the CSV owners template.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
